name: Group chat wrapped
summary: A tap-through story recap of the group chat itself: messages sent, top emoji, most active hour, the running saga and the MVP.
useWhen: end of a year or semester and the chat wants a recap of itself
someone asks for the chat's wrapped, its stats, who talks most
dontUseWhen: a recap of a trip (use trip-story)
a semester recap as cards to collect (use semester-wrapped)
no real counts were given: never invent stats

params.perDay: one line under the bar race
params.quote: {who, text} a reaction shown once pinned
